Professor Alvarez — John here. I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. My free half-hours are:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30
- Tuesday 15:00-15:30
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30

Would one of those work for you? Happy to fit around whatever else you have.
Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Would Monday 14:00-14:30 work, or Friday 11:00-11:30? Happy to fit another slot if you'd rather. Thanks, Sarah

Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my schedule, these times are free for me:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 15:00-15:30
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30

Please let me know which one works for you (or suggest another time in working hours) and I'll confirm it on my calendar.

Best regards,
Priya
John — Monday 10:00-10:30 works for me. I've put it in my calendar; please put it in yours so it's properly booked. See you then. — Alvarez
Perfect, thank you — Monday 10:00-10:30 is in my calendar now. See you then.
Sarah — Monday 14:00-14:30 works for me. It's in my calendar; please put it in yours so it's properly booked. See you then. — Alvarez
Priya — Tuesday 15:00-15:30 works for me. It's in my calendar; please put it in yours so it's properly booked. Best, Alvarez
